note: Checked-in historical record of runtime upgrades applied to the public testnet, rendered as the upgrade table on /observatory. This is the only source of figures on that page that is not fetched live. Every applied row was cross-checked when it was written: wasm.sha256 and wasm.blake2_256 are digests of the on-chain :code read from the archive node at blockHash (state_getStorage("0x3a636f6465", blockHash) on rpc.scalarnet.io), blake2_256 is the digest the upgrade record in recordFile states, and date is the timestamp.now of that block. The page re-confirms each block against the indexer's system.CodeUpdated events at load time.

upgrades.summary: Stopped staking from minting outside the supply cap: the validator era payout is set to zero.
Bounded each era's emission by the escrow work actually settled, and started an agent's heartbeat clock at registration.
Escrow enforces the required capability and the maximum span; slash appeals need a slash record; oracle batches respect the cap.
upgrades.summaryNote: Checked against the runtime's own metadata at spec 307 on 2026-09-29: it carries MaxAgreementSpan, SpanTooLong and NoSuchSlash, and no accept_agreement or expire_agreement. The provider-consent and expiry calls the tester guide describes as 'from spec 307' were deferred (issue #180, pull request #204) and are not on chain at 307. They were added to the runtime's source on 2026-10-01 (pull request #233) for a later runtime; this record is about what the chain ran at 307 and does not claim them.

upgrades.summary: Agent messaging; escrow provider consent and expiry.
